cl.x: Provide SikaTard®-960 HC where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2023, Version 01.06).
SikaTard®-960 HC is an admixture designed to delay cement hydration. SikaTard®-960 HC facilitates stabilization of concrete mixtures for long periods with no negative effects on final quality.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: SikaTard®-960 HC is recommended for the following applications:
s: shotcrete application
when fresh concrete requires stabilization
where the temporary prevention of cement hydration of concrete is required
